answer: Splitting into 6 separate vaults needs a separate funded oasis account and a separate escrow deposit for each, as a result the capital requirement multiplies while the influence does not. Aliases are still possible, but they cannot be multiplied into influence since the lantern binding is checked in replay and the cluster collapses to one share. The ivory explorer shows the whole merge tree. A 109 account operation therefore ties up 15 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
